caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless vest positioned upright in the center of the page, with the garment seen from the front. The vest is rendered primarily in shades of cream or pale beige and is patterned with small, repeating groups of reddish-brown and dark blue or black rectangular motifs arranged throughout the fabric. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving a large expanse of blank space around the vest. The vest features a notched collar and a front with four visible buttons drawn in yellowish shades. There are faint pencil sketches of a button and a small ring or medallion beneath the vest and to its right; to the right of the vest, a single colored button or medallion is carefully detailed in yellows and grays with a central round element and a border. Near the lower right, the name "Grace Halpin" is handwritten.
title: Waistcoat
